title: Security review - EmberCart Commerce
summary: Security questionnaire review (SOC 2, encryption, RBAC). Customer did not raise data residency; focus was on prompt logging and retention.
transcript:
Meeting: Security review - EmberCart Commerce
Date: 2025-02-25
Duration: 38 min

[00:00] Logan (Redwood): Hey Marco, Jules. Lets go through your checklist.
[00:20] Marco (EmberCart): Yeah. We need SOC 2 and encryption details.

[03:10] Irene (Redwood): Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We support KMS integrations in certain deployments.

[07:40] Jules (EmberCart): Do you store prompts? We want prompt logging disabled by default.
[07:52] Irene: We log minimal metadata; you can disable prompt capture. For Private, prompts never leave your boundary.

[15:05] Marco: How do you do access control?
[15:10] Logan: RBAC, SSO/SAML, and audit logging are available.

[29:30] Jules: Cool. I think thats most of it.
[37:10] Logan: Ill send the report and docs.
